content.title: Dialogue Reaction | Calm to Laughter Trigger
content.summary: Start in a stable two-person setup and establish the first speaking turn in a shared frame. After a readable pause, give the second character one short reply in a closer shot, then return to the first character's longer nonverbal reaction.

quick_start.input_format: Stable two-person geography + complete first speaking turn + readable pause + short second reply + longer silent physical reaction
quick_start.recommended_input: Two lunar geologists first establish their geography in a two-shot as Person A completes one short line. After a readable pause, Person B gives one brief reply in a closer shot; the camera then returns to Person A for a longer silent reaction—hugging the helmet and leaning back—with no third speaking turn.
required_anchors: Establish both subjects and their seating geography before moving to singles.
Keep the second speaking turn concise and visibly complete.
Return to the first subject for a longer non-speaking physical reaction.
End on a changed held posture with no additional speaking turn.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Two-person dialogue scenes with stable geography: complete the first speaking turn, give the second subject one compact reply, then return to an extended silent reaction from the first subject.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Keep two subjects in stable seated geography, establish the first visible speaking turn in a shared frame, give the second subject one compact reply in closer proof, then return to the first subject for a prolonged non-speaking physical reaction. Dialogue meaning may be original instance content, but the reusable source evidence is the turn-pause-reaction timing and shot handoff.

invariants.rule: Establish both subjects and seating geography before singles.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting on isolated close-ups weakens the exchange.

invariants.rule: Keep the second speaking turn compact and visibly complete.
invariants.purpose: Creates a precise visual handoff to the later reaction.
invariants.ablation_failure: An extended turn steals time from the non-speaking reaction.

invariants.rule: Use stable eye lines and prop continuity across cuts.
invariants.purpose: Makes the edit feel like one exchange.

invariants.rule: Return to the first subject for a longer non-speaking physical reaction.
invariants.purpose: Makes performance, not exposition, carry the consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: An immediate verbal comeback removes the reaction space.

invariants.rule: End on a changed held posture with no additional speaking turn.
invariants.ablation_failure: Another line restarts the exchange instead of completing the reaction hold.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source tavern-like living room and costumes
source exact drinking and laughter performance
